name: ProMeta repository change
description: Plan, implement, review, validate, and prepare GitHub operations for a zWorkforce repository change.

steps.prompt: Classify this repository change request and identify affected domains: {{input.request}}
Create implementation steps and acceptance criteria from: {{steps.triage.result}}
Implement the approved scoped change with tests: {{steps.plan.result}}
Review the implementation for bugs, regressions, and missing tests: {{steps.implement.result}}
Review security boundaries and policy impact: {{steps.implement.result}}
Run release validation and summarize readiness: {{steps.review.result}} {{steps.security.result}}

name: ProMeta release readiness
description: Verify release, artifact provenance, GitHub checks, and compliance evidence.

steps.prompt: Verify release candidate {{input.version}} with local and GitHub evidence.
Verify release artifacts, SBOMs, checksums, packages, and rollback evidence: {{steps.verify.result}}
Inspect PRs, checks, branches, releases, and package state for release {{input.version}}.
Produce GO, NO-GO, or CONDITIONAL release governance decision from: {{steps.artifacts.result}} {{steps.github.result}}

name: ProMeta incident response
description: Coordinate zWorkforce production incident triage, database checks, security review, rollback, and evidence.

steps.prompt: Open incident loop for {{input.incident}}. State severity, impact, containment, and next checks.
Check health, queues, schedulers, outbox, providers, and deploy state: {{steps.command.result}}
Verify PostgreSQL health, backup posture, migrations, and recovery risk: {{steps.command.result}}
Check auth, secrets, policy, audit, and suspicious events: {{steps.command.result}}
Validate timeline, evidence, rollback decision, residual risk, and follow-up tasks.

name: ProMeta Z.A.R.V.I.S. validation
description: Validate Z.A.R.V.I.S. contracts, package-local services, release evidence, and Windows compatibility.

steps.prompt: Validate packages/zarvis contracts, services, apps, zctl, docs, and Windows compatibility for {{input.scope}}.
Review Z.A.R.V.I.S. security, secrets, local action, memory, perception, and owner-domain boundaries: {{steps.contracts.result}}
Verify package release readiness and evidence from: {{steps.contracts.result}} {{steps.security.result}}
